messages:
sam-sales: Quick sync  Prospect AsterTech is blocked on staging until we provide SOC 2 summary, ISO27001 cert, and a signed pen-test attestation. They also want EU-only residency for the POC. Can we deliver today?

ari-se: I can pull the SOC2 summary and a redacted control mapping. Need to know which org/user fields to redact.

hana-security: We provide SOC2 Type II summary + redacted control matrix for POCs. Full report needs NDA + secure transfer. ISO cert PDF ok to share.

lucas-ps: Procurement wants a pen-test attestation on letterhead with a named signer. Do we have a template? Who signs?

hana-security: Yes. Standard wording: "Redwood Inference attests that a third-party penetration test was completed on YYYY-MM and no critical open findings were present at the time of reporting." I can sign as Director of Security today.

artifact-bot: action: presigned S3 link created (expires in 7d)  DM'd to sam-sales (link hidden).

sam-sales: They also asked about KMS separation for the POC. If they require customer-managed keys we need Dedicated/Private and ~72h to provision.

ari-se: For a short POC we can run Hosted in eu-west-1 with network isolation; pricing delta applies. I'll send a quick estimate tomorrow.

lucas-ps: Next steps: 1) hana upload signed pen-test attestation to presigned link TODAY, 2) ari upload SOC2 summary + ISO cert to link TODAY, 3) ari send eu pricing delta TOMORROW, 4) lucas schedule audit walkthrough if they want one.

hana-security: Will upload signed attestation and include contact info.

sam-sales: Thanks all ":thumbsup:"
